title: bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2: Special Tower Number Field Sieve (STNFS) over h(Y) = Y^6 - 2Y^3 + 2 with verified F_{p^12} isomorphism, concrete 39-limb ECM descent, and unfiltered M^T D M Block-Wiedemann

claims.statement: For uniform nonidentity P in G1 and uniform z in GT on BLS12-381, the Special Tower Number Field Sieve (STNFS) attack in proof.md computes g = e(P, Q0) in GT, maps g and z into F_p[y, X]/(y^6 - 2*y^3 + 2, X^2 - u*y) via the verified F_p-algebra isomorphism iota: w^2 -> y, w -> s^(-1)*X where s = u^((p+1)/4) mod p in F_p^* satisfies s^2 == u mod p, recovers a in [0, r) satisfying g^a = z at parameters A = 1360 and B = 2^67.500, and returns Q = [a]Q0 in G2 satisfying e(P, Q) = z. Under the four standard STNFS heuristics explicitly listed in Section 6 of proof.md (Barbulescu-Duquesne + Guillevic-Singh Murphy-alpha and direct joint Dickman smoothness, Poisson relation yield, rectangular M^T D M sparse kernel rank over core ideals of norm <= 2^65.0, and 12-dimensional proper-subfield single-norm LLL smoothing + 3-level side-aware special-q descent), the attack succeeds with probability at least 0.40 over uniform challenges and fresh algorithm coins using at most 2^129.900000 total target-group-operation equivalents (normalized by C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instructions per reference dense F_{p^12} multiplication, corresponding to at most 2^144.135690 scalar AArch64 instructions, charging 12D bucket/line sieving, unfiltered flt = 1 rectangular M^T D M Block-Wiedemann linear algebra with the machine-verified deterministic worst-case row weight bound of 245 prime-ideal columns and 40 derived Schirokauer unit columns per row, and concrete 39-limb CIOS Montgomery ECM + 3-level special-q descent). Peak memory is at most 2^78.000000 bytes; preprocessing is at most 2^129.900000 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in total work; nonuniform advice is 0 bytes (2^0 bytes) and is included in memory.

experiments.purpose: Machine-check sequential Frobenius powers Y^(p^1)..Y^(p^6) mod (p, h(Y)), non-residuosity (u*y)^((p^6-1)/2) == -1, and the explicit F_p-algebra isomorphism iota: w -> s^(-1)*X where s = u^((p+1)/4) mod p; compute exact 1/zeta_{K_h}(2) and exact local root counts for alpha(f_y, h, B0) and alpha(g_y, h, B0) across all ideal degrees d in {1, 2, 3, 6} and bad primes; evaluate both the Barbulescu-Duquesne + Murphy-alpha and direct joint smoothness yields at A = 1360 and B = 2^67.500; audit the concrete 39-limb CIOS Montgomery ECM cost/failure bound and side-aware 3-level special-q descent tree; and verify the complete instruction and memory ledgers.
